You can use `objectFit` to control cropping and scaling. - `"contain"`: The image will be scaled down to fit the container and preserve aspect ratio. - `"cover"`: The image will fill the container and be cropped. > Learn more about [`position`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position) and [`object-fit`](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/object-fit). #### `loader` A custom function used to generate the image URL.
